data.title: Neftchi Fargona vs Al Ittihad: Where to watch, TV channel, live stream & kick-off time | Goal.com India
data.content:
Al Ittihad have won two of their last five, with their form split sharply between domestic and continental competition. They beat Al Diriyah 2-0 and Al-Ettifaq 4-1 in the Saudi Pro League but lost both of their recent AFC Champions League Elite matches, including a 2-1 defeat to Shabab Al-Ahli Dubai. A draw against Al-Shamal and a loss to Al Hilal complete the picture. They have scored 10 goals in those five games while conceding seven.

### Head-to-Head Record [...] Al Ittihad arrive under Jens Wissing having lost their last AFC Champions League Elite outing, going down 2-1 to Shabab Al-Ahli Dubai. Their Saudi Pro League form has been sharper, though a defeat to Al Hilal shows they are not without vulnerability.
